headline: AI-Powered Cybersecurity Threat Detection System Built by B.Tech Student
summary: A student developed a web application using Machine Learning to identify malicious network activity and classify traffic.
details: A B.Tech Computer Science student has developed an AI-powered cybersecurity threat detection system. The project leverages Machine Learning to identify potentially malicious network activity and classify network traffic.

The web-based application aims to bring together technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Web Development, and Cloud Computing into a practical tool. The student is looking to further improve the project and explore new technologies.

The system's GitHub repository is available for review, showcasing the code and architecture behind the threat detection capabilities. A live demo is also accessible, allowing users to interact with the application.
This project highlights the innovative work being done by students in the cybersecurity field, demonstrating how advanced AI and ML techniques can be applied to real-world security challenges.
caption:
Student builds AI-powered cybersecurity threat detection system using Python and Machine Learning. Explore the GitHub repo and live demo.

A B.Tech Computer Science student has developed an AI-powered cybersecurity threat detection system. The project leverages Machine Learning to identify potentially malicious network activity and classify network traffic.

The web-based application aims to bring together technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Web Development, and Cloud Computing into a practical tool. The student is looking to further improve the project and explore new technologies.

The system's GitHub repository is available for review, showcasing the code and architecture behind the threat detection capabilities. A live demo is also accessible, allowing users to interact with the application.

This project highlights the innovative work being done by students in the cybersecurity field, demonstrating how advanced AI and ML techniques can be applied to real-world security challenges.
